trials.unit: exposure trials with a full 14-day observation window

verdict.verdict: simple contagion pattern: first-exposure association exceeds the shuffled null; no clear evidence that distinct exposers reinforce adoption

matched_controls.ci95_method: player-cluster Poisson bootstrap; both pair members

predictive.reading: repertoire proximity is worth +0.0123 AUC over the baseline; knowing who played the opening at the player adds at most +0.0244 on top of it

corrections: Only exposure trials with full 14-day follow-up are included, regardless of outcome.
Matched controls are unexposed and unadopted at t0; rating and activity use only prior games.
Player-cluster bootstrap weights both exposed and control players in the matched interval.
Prediction uses background features before evaluated trials and group-held-out spells.
The shuffled-time reference uses 20 permutations on the cached January slice.

analysis_revision.follow_up: complete windows only; late positive and negative trials excluded
analysis_revision.controls: risk-set controls; rating and activity measured strictly before each matching time
analysis_revision.prediction: background features before trials; held-out player-opening-colour spells
analysis_revision.source: cached January 2016 game slice; archive not reparsed
analysis_revision.uncertainty: 400-replicate player-cluster Poisson bootstrap for matched difference

historical_robustness_tables: Secondary robustness CSVs have not yet been rerun after the follow-up correction.
